name: Geometric-Vector-Stress-Obfuscation
description: Replaces the discrete bitwise XOR signature and popcount condition with a continuous geometric vector sum and squared Euclidean length. The vectors are chosen such that the squared length of the sum is 4 for distinct channels and 16 for identical channels, meaning the total stress is exactly 4m if and only if all connected nodes have distinct channels. This completely removes the discrete logic affordances that the models used to pattern-match the 3-coloring reduction, forcing them to reason through the geometry to discover the discrete constraint.
